name: reflective-lookup-registered-method
description: A method of a defined type T is retained by reflective-lookup where a string literal spells its name in a call that passes a value of T or *T to a function or method outside the analyzed program: each item of the string separated by a semicolon spells one name, after an optional prefix ending in a colon, the verbs a router maps to the method. An exported method no such string names is reported.
